[quote=corzerran;61392328]The royal family of Corzerran arrived at Velnaz on Sunday a little after midday. They arrived at the palace in short order in a black car with golden highlights.

The first to step out was King Zachariasz, dressed in royal robes with golden scales. He went around to the other side of the vehicle and opened the door for his wife, Queen Szkarłat, taking her by the hand as she stood out of her seat; she wore a white royal robe decorated with golden patterns. The next three to exit the vehicle were Prince Joshua, the heir to the throne, Princess Kain, the minister of war, and Prince Abel, the minister of diplomacy. Soon, after the car was parked, the twin guards Mateusz and Katarzyna Strzelecka joined the royal family.

Together, the group walked towards the palace doors.[/quote]
The doors opened in tandem, Elena on the other side. She stood with a few members of palace staff, Service workers ready to help with luggage.
She wore her olive trenchcoat, a black button down, and grey slacks. Her hair was secured in a braid, with little clips that had various green/yellow stones.
The doors closed behind the family as they entered, and Elena approached. [i]Your Excellency. Many thanks for your visit. How was travel? Could the staff help you with your belongings?"[/i]
She spoke with the typical 'stani stoicism and a cold demeanor. [i]"And a pleasure to see you once again, Kain. I hope alls been well?"[/i]
The Palace staff began moving about their duties, bringing luggage from place to place.
